If you collect at a SAPO (Post Office) or Cash Paymaster point, arrive early and bring your original ID document.

contentBlocks.text: Q2 Review Cycle for SRD Grants

July marks the second quarter review cycle for the SRD R370 grant. All SRD applicants must ensure their banking details and contact information are up to date on the SASSA SRD website. If your application status shows 'pending' or 'review,' log in to check whether any additional documents are required.

contentBlocks.title: Update Your Banking Details Now
contentBlocks.text: SASSA conducts quarterly reviews of SRD beneficiaries. If your banking details have changed since you last applied, update them immediately on the SRD portal. Payments may be delayed if SASSA cannot verify your account.
Tips for Collecting Your Grant in July

items: Wait at least 48 hours after the payment date before visiting collection points to allow systems to process.
Avoid the first three days of the payment cycle — queues are longest then.
Use your SASSA gold card at any Shoprite, Checkers, Pick n Pay, Boxer, or USave till point for free withdrawals.
SAPO (Post Office) branches may have different operating hours during July — check your local branch beforehand.
If you lost your card, request a replacement at your nearest SASSA office immediately.

faqs.question: What if my payment date falls on a weekend?
faqs.answer: When a payment date falls on a Saturday or Sunday, SASSA typically processes payments on the preceding Friday. Some collection points may also operate on Saturday. Check with your local pay point for exact availability.

faqs.question: Can I collect my grant at any retailer or only the one I registered with?
faqs.answer: You can collect at any participating retailer — Shoprite, Checkers, Pick n Pay, Boxer, or USave — regardless of where you registered. You do not need to stick to one store. Simply swipe your SASSA gold card and choose the withdrawal option.

faqs.question: Why does my SRD say 'pending' even though July payment dates are published?
faqs.answer: SRD applications are reviewed monthly. If your status shows 'pending' in July, it means SASSA is still verifying your details for this month's payment cycle. Log into the SRD portal to check if any documents are outstanding. Payments for approved applicants will be processed on 14 July.

faqs.question: I receive the Older Persons Grant. Do I need to reapply every year?
faqs.answer: No. The Older Persons Grant is a permanent grant. You do not need to reapply. However, SASSA may conduct periodic reviews, so ensure your contact details are up to date at your local office.

faqs.question: What should I do if I did not receive my payment on the scheduled date?
faqs.answer: Wait 48 hours and check your balance again. If the money is still not showing, contact the SASSA toll-free helpline on 0800 60 10 11 or visit your nearest SASSA office. Do not pay anyone to 'resolve' a missing payment.

contentBlocks.title: Post Office Collections Continue
contentBlocks.text: SASSA continues to use SAPO (South African Post Office) as a payment channel alongside retail partners. If you collect at a Post Office, verify your branch's operating hours as some branches may have adjusted schedules. Note that not all Post Office branches process SASSA payments — confirm before travelling.
